title: Remote Access
subtitle: View and control VibeValley on this Mac from your phone directly over the same Wi-Fi LAN, or over optional Tailscale WAN.

mode.label: Connection mode
mode.lanHint: Connect phones on the same Wi-Fi directly without Tailscale
mode.tailscaleHint: Connect from outside your local network over encrypted Tailscale WAN

lan.label: LAN direct (same Wi-Fi)
lan.hint: No Tailscale required; auto-detects this Mac's non-loopback LAN IPv4

tailscale.optionalHint: Optional WAN enhancement; LAN direct works even without Tailscale

pair.qrHint: Scan the QR code on your phone, or enter the address and pairing code

mobile.pairSubtitle: Scan the QR code in Remote Access settings on your Mac, or enter the LAN / Tailscale address and one-time pairing code.
mobile.invalidInput: Enter a valid address, pairing code, and device name.

state.unauthorized: Access revoked or expired. Pair again.

inbox.empty: Inbox is clear. Nothing needs your attention.

channel.empty: No messages in this channel yet.

controlPlane.title: Control plane connection
controlPlane.subtitle: Choose whether this Mac runs an embedded local server or connects to a remote control plane.
controlPlane.restartToRemote: Remote target {url} saved. Restart VibeValley to switch connections.
controlPlane.restartToEmbedded: Switched back to local embedded mode. Restart VibeValley to apply.
